title: Room guidance: shelter + laundry (card 7), 21 Nov 2026
weak: The services rooms (counselling, case-worker, interview, reception, staff office 2) are judged design sizes (14 Nov), not code or published guidance. Labelled "judged".
The laundry ratio comes from two sources that disagree (1 washer per 25 guests vs 1 per 50); both shown. Nothing in the tool checks the count against guests.
Occupant-load rates and the fixture table are named by clause, not reproduced.
In the generated zone layouts the services floor is labelled "Clinic" (the emergency hub layout relabelled). It is services, not a clinic; the card should say so.
